title: Centurion
sourceLines: -A commander of approximately one-hundred soldiers in the Roman army Mr 15:44,45; Ac 21:32; 22:25,26; 23:17,23; 24:23
-Of Capernaum, comes to Jesus in behalf of his servant Mt 8:5-13; Lu 7:1-10
-In charge of the soldiers who crucified Jesus, testifies, “Truly this was the Son of God,” Mt 27:54; Mr 15:39; Lu 23:47
